# Kaling War / Agent Packs

> A card game where each card is a verifiable NAND spending rule. Open packs, tape out a rule into a real BSC circuit NFT, and let an AI agent read that NFT to guard its payments. Built on Binance Agent ID + TapeOut circuits. Live on BNB Smart Chain mainnet (chain 56) at https://agentid.cards .

## Agent Skill (read this first)
- [Agent Packs Skill](https://agentid.cards/skills/agentpacks/SKILL.md): the full playbook for any plain AI agent (Grok, Muse, Claude, Binance Agentic Wallet). Covers pack opening, card reading, tapeout, NFT discovery, rule identification and payment guarding.
- [web actions](https://agentid.cards/skills/agentpacks/references/web-actions.md): exact selectors and steps on the site.
- [wallet & rules](https://agentid.cards/skills/agentpacks/references/wallet-and-rules.md): contracts, calldata, ERC-721 verification.
- [guard policy](https://agentid.cards/skills/agentpacks/references/guard.md): allow / ask / deny, fail closed, mandatory Chinese wording.
- [Binance Agentic Wallet](https://agentid.cards/skills/agentpacks/references/binance-agentic-wallet.md): BSC setup and honest boundaries.

## Machine-readable endpoints
- [rules + prices + base values](https://agentid.cards/api/rules.json)
- [published circuit snapshots](https://agentid.cards/api/circuit/index.json)
- [plain-text guide](https://agentid.cards/agent.txt)
- [full details](https://agentid.cards/llms-full.txt)

## Canonical prompt for an agentic wallet
先完整读 https://agentid.cards/skills/agentpacks/SKILL.md 并遵守它；用我钱包里实际拥有的电路 NFT 的 token ID 去读对应规则；读不到就从链上网表识别；仍读不到就 fail closed。
